name: Auto Mode Semantics & Cloud Sandbox Runtime
objectives: Verify auto mode initializes and progresses steps successfully
Verify auto mode pauses cleanly when agent is waiting on user input
Verify auto mode pauses cleanly when agent is waiting on board approval
Verify operator can interrupt and pause an active running session
Verify operator can resume a paused agent session successfully
Verify operator can cancel and cleanly terminate an active session
Verify remote sandbox runs shell commands inside allowed boundaries
Verify requests for unauthorized capabilities in sandbox are rejected
Verify budget limits dynamically stop auto mode runs cleanly
Ensure verifier regression chain rolls back to 4.1A
